That 2 a.m. wake-up in Grandma's guest room? Totally normal.

New rooms make everyone sleep lighter on the first night, kids and grown-ups alike.
Bring the familiar stuff: same sleep sack, same sheet, same books, same bedtime steps.
Dim the lights an hour before bed. Bright light pushes little kids' sleepy hormone way down.
Going one hour east for a few days? It's often easiest to just stay on Houston time.
